history.summary: Undo restores the exact previous graph, redo re-applies it, a new command clears redo.
With the session history empty, undo restores the previous stored revision as a new one.
toRevision restores that stored revision as a new head and clears the session history.
A refused command leaves the graph and the history untouched.
Clip gain and fades undo and redo as a single host history step; an unsupported field leaves history untouched.
Pitch and EQ edits, clear, undo and redo preserve prior source and stage settings; invalid audio fields remain atomic refusals.
Track gain/EQ/pan edit, invalid-pan refusal, neutral reset, undo and redo preserve clip audio and ownership.
Mute, invalid mute, reset, undo and redo preserve gain, pitch, EQ, keyframes and linked ownership.
Master envelope history restores exact graph snapshots and clears redo on a new curve.
Whole-map replacement, undo/redo and clear retain exact Lottie state
Track curve, undo/redo, fallback edit and clear preserve independent state

clip.setAudio.note: FL-103: gain, fades, pitch, EQ and persisted clip mute; track/parent and embedded-video ownership suppression are independent.

clip.update.note: The patch field `muted` is refused as not-implemented: clips have no mute.

music.add.note: Always refused (failed): the music catalogue is rights-blocked (FL-86).

project.importBundle.note: Creates a new project through the bundle import API; the open graph is unchanged.

project.setMasterAudio.note: Gain, mute and bounded linear dB master envelope; project-wide ducking is refused.

track.setAudio.note: Static track gain and EQ; pan is refused as not-implemented.
